**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-source obligation on Sparkling:

- **§ 2 (p0028)** — the licence Garman grants us is "non-transferable and non-exclusive"; that is a scope limit on the licence in our favour, not an exclusive-dealing covenant binding us.
- **§ 3 (Restrictions on Use)** — only standard copying, sublicence/assignment, reverse-engineering and third-party-precaution limits; nothing requiring us to buy from Garman.
- **§ 10 (Maintenance & Support) / § 11 (Fees)** — no requirement to source maintenance, updates or any other products exclusively from Garman, and no bar on engaging third parties.
- Other "exclusive" hits are the § 15 exclusive-remedy clause and § 20(h) non-exclusive jurisdiction — neither is a restrictive covenant.

This sits at the **preferred** position: we keep full freedom to buy from other suppliers, so no edit is warranted.
